A.flow: A: the customer comes to the business (video or phone count as A)

services.name: DJ starter session
services.story: The main story: a $140 DJ starter session (2½ hours, one to one). A $40 deposit now, and the $100 rest at the studio.

services.name: Mixing lesson
services.story: A $35 mixing lesson. A card is saved for the studio's $20 fee. Alex pays at the studio.

services.name: Mixing lesson
services.story: A $35 mixing lesson for a returning student. Nothing is taken: a YES books it.

services.name: Private lesson
services.story: A $55 private lesson (60 minutes), paid in full when booking.

services.name: Custom mix
services.story: A custom mix for a dance routine, priced from the song list at $90. Booked once Sam OKs it, and paid at the studio.

B.flow: B: the business goes to the customer

services.name: Birthday party DJ
services.story: The main story: a 2-hour birthday party, quoted from Alex's plan at $640 (over $500, so Sam OKs it). Both sign the contract. A $160 deposit holds the date, and the $480 rest goes on the saved card at DONE.

services.name: Birthday party DJ
services.story: A company party, quoted from the plan at $640 (over $500, so Sam OKs it). Both sign the contract, a $160 deposit holds the date, and the rest, with any overtime, goes on the bill after.

services.name: Kids' party
services.story: A $150 kids' party (2 hours). A $40 deposit now, and the $110 rest on the saved card at DONE.

services.name: Kids' party
services.story: The $150 kids' party, paid in full when booking.

questions_before_times: The kind of event: a party, a wedding, a company or school event
The date, and the start and end time
The venue's name and town (for the travel fee), and indoors, outdoors or both
About how many guests (it sets the sound system)
Add-ons: uplighting, a second room, ceremony sound
At the studio: the lesson and the level, or the rental night
safety_stop: Someone hurt, a fire, or a fight at the venue right now
license: None for DJ work in most places. A local business license where the city or county asks for one: from the state form.
staff_skills: ["Weddings and MC work (leads only)","Parties and company events","Kids' parties","Lighting","Lessons","Rentals"]
messages_never: Gate codes, access notes, a child's details and family notes stay on the secure page. The do-not-play list and the timeline stay on the music form. Texts to the DJ carry none of them either.
demo_note: Demo data for testing only. [G] = prefilled from the business's Google listing at sign-up; the owner checks each field.
